title: A front-desk login can switch on "train at every branch" for a member, although only the owner is meant to
what: On the add or edit member form, the "train at every branch" choice is shown to the owner only. But the server takes any change to a member from a front-desk login without looking at that choice, so a desk login that sends the change outside the panel's own screens can let a member check in at every branch. The panel's own notes say the server enforces the desk's limits on writes; this one is missing.
expected: The server refuses a front-desk change that turns "train at every branch" on or off, the same way it refuses desk changes to plans, receipts and memberships, and a database test proves it.
who: owners with two or more branches
how_often: only when someone at the desk sends the change outside the panel's screens
fix_line: Make the server refuse a desk login's change to the every-branch choice, and add a test for it

items.reason: The forms reach the server three ways. (1) Every save (add or edit member, sell, collect, cancel receipt, extra days, move start) goes through crm_push, open to anyone but each call works out the gym from the sign-in key; a front-desk key may not touch plans, expenses or gym details, may not change a saved receipt or membership, and is held to 10% off and 31 days back. (2) The desk photo goes through owner_save_member_photo (owner or desk key, own gym's live member only). (3) Online pay and closing open links go to the pay server routes, judged in the pay area. Gap: the every-branch choice on a member is owner-only on screen but not on the server.

Tables this area writes: crm_records (row rules on, no rule, apps cannot read it; other gym refused in security.sql 6a-6c and every ownerB cell of the access matrix); gym_member_photos (row rules on, no rule; other gym refused in the 0043 test, checks 6 and 7); gyms (crm_version only; security.sql 6b proves gym B's version is untouched); crm_push_log (row rules on, no rule; no other-gym test).

Rule applied: crm_push_log (the repeat-save list) has no other-gym test, only the all-tables read loop run while it is empty; the code looks it up by the key's own gym. Same cause as an existing finding, reused.
Rule applied: no live cross-gym attempt was run; no database rows were read.
No key pattern hit in this area; the forms hold no key, only the signed-in session key passed to the server. Payment-company keys stay on the server.
No AI key or paid service key is used by these forms; online payment keys never reach the panel.
The forms have no sign-in, PIN or session code; they use the session the sign-in area gives (sessions never expiring is already a finding there).

Every text box is shown back through React, which escapes it; the panel has no raw-HTML output anywhere (searched). Text is stored as JSON with no SQL built from it, capped at 20 KB a record. Spreadsheet export guards cells starting with = + - @, and the Excel export writes text cells.

The only upload is the desk camera photo on Add member: the server takes it only for a live member of the key's own gym, only a JPEG (checks the first bytes), at most 100 KB; tests prove another gym's member, a removed member, a wrong key and a too-big photo are refused.

The forms make no public link. New record ids are random (browser random id), and the only link opened is the panel's own member page, which needs a sign-in. Online payment links are made by the pay area.
At run time the forms use only react, react-dom and the shared theme package; none has an alert. The sheet library alerts belong to the export area, vite alerts are build-time only.
